tools.name: cad2cube_import_dxf
tools.description: Import DXF (CAD2Cube): Import an AutoCAD DXF file with CAD2Cube. Settings that are not parameters here come from the add-on's panel.

units_mode.description: How to determine the scale factor

manual_scale.description: Multiplier applied to every coordinate. Used when Units = Manual

layer_mode.description: How DXF layers map to Blender

layer_filter.description: Comma-separated layer names to import (empty = all). Prefix a name with '!' to exclude it

block_mode.description: How to handle INSERT entities (block references)

import_text.description: Import TEXT and MTEXT entities as Blender text objects

import_points.description: Import POINT entities as empty axes

hatch_mode.description: How to handle HATCH fill regions

merge_3d_faces.description: Combine all imported 3DFACE entities into one Blender mesh and weld shared vertices. Useful for terrain meshes from Civil 3D or any surface composed of many triangles. Off by default since most architectural files don't need it

color_by_layer.description: Tint objects with their CAD layer color in the viewport (object color only — no materials, does not affect render). Makes the import look like the original CAD drawing

skip_hidden_layers.description: Skip layers that are off, frozen, or locked in the source file

import_linetypes.description: Render non-continuous lines (Dashed, Hidden, Center, Dot) as dashed curves

linetype_scale.description: Multiplier for dash patterns (in addition to DXF $LTSCALE)

curve_resolution.description: Segments per full revolution for arcs, ellipses, splines

flatten_z.description: Force Z = 0 on every entity (useful for 2D drawings with Z noise)

auto_join_curves.description: Chain connected curve segments on the same layer into continuous/closed splines

auto_join_tolerance.description: Maximum distance (in meters) to weld endpoints together

recenter_mode.description: How to position imported geometry relative to Blender's origin

join_by_layer.description: Merge all curves on the same layer into a single object (faster scene)

frame_after_import.description: Zoom the viewport to the imported geometry and fix clipping distance
